data.title: Machine intelligence and crypto will merge naturally: Ethereum co-founder
data.description: Joseph Lubin, Ethereum co-founder and MetaMask Chairman & CEO, says AI can provide creativity and expertise but does not itself create trust. He expects a natural merger of machine intelligence and crypto, with decentralized protocols providing trusted execution. Lubin also says the crypto industry will gain regulatory clarity through SEC and CFTC action, even as the Clarity Act remains stalled in the Senate.
